title: Accounting, bookkeeping or a finance team

tasks.title: Invoice check before payment
tasks.when: an invoice must be checked before it is paid
steps: Read supplier, amount, VAT, due date and bank details.
Compare them with the order and the supplier's last invoice.
Say pay, hold or ask, and why.
tasks.output: one line per invoice in invoices-checked.md
checks: compares the bank details with the last invoice

examples.input: Invoice 2026-114, 1210 EUR incl. VAT 21%, new IBAN.

tasks.title: Month-end close notes
tasks.when: the month closes and the team needs the open items
steps: List unreconciled items and their amounts.
Write what each owner must bring and by when.

examples.input: Bank 4 items unreconciled, 320 EUR; owner: Ana.
